hardware.candidate_role: USB/display signer physical-button logic regression guard
hardware.tested_state: host-buildable debounce and short/long press state machine shared by ESP-IDF GPIO polling adapter

procedure: Factored the T-Display S3 button debounce and short/long press classification into a host-buildable module used by the ESP-IDF GPIO polling adapter.
Added host-core tests for ignored sub-debounce presses, short KEY/GPIO14 next events, and long BOOT/GPIO0 reject events.
Ran NostrSeal/esp32 make ci with 38 Python tests, host-core tests, compileall, and firmware validation.
Exported ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell invocation used for build, flash, and smoke.
Verified idf.py and esptool.py paths and confirmed idf.py --version reported ESP-IDF v5.5.4.
Built clean app version c5c59f2 with make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-flash.
Flashed bootloader, app, and partition table to /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 and verified image hashes.
expected_result: The firmware still builds, flashes, and preserves the disabled signing protocol contract after the physical-button logic refactor.
observed_result: ESP-IDF v5.5.4 built app version c5c59f2 with binary size 0x8a8c0 and 0x75740 bytes free in the app partition. esptool detected ESP32-S3 QFN56 revision v0.2 with native USB-Serial/JTAG and MAC ec:da:3b:95:32:98, wrote bootloader, app, and partition-table images, and verified hashes. The smoke passed with 35 verified exchanges: 8 valid response frames and 27 expected rejection frames. sign_event remained signing_disabled.
limitations: This run verifies build, flash, and protocol behavior after a physical-button logic refactor; it is not a new manual button-press acceptance run.
The button tests exercise deterministic host-buildable debounce and short/long press classification, not production physical-control acceptance.
The protocol response for sign_event remains signing_disabled.
No persistent key custody, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, enclosure, or production approval policy was validated.
